purpose: Audit/refactor overlay for genomics lane scope qualifiers after rev0018-rev0019 candidate-gene/control passes.
findings: The genomics lane needed a common scope overlay to prevent both anti-genetics and naive universal-transfer interpretations.
Controls and negative results are more useful when phenotype tightness, effect size, actionability, population scope, and governance are kept separate.
The overlay is intentionally provisional and not yet a global schema mandate.
open_debt: Second-pass review of every scope_qualifiers value.
Source-code/methods audit of dynamic diversity monitor.
